label: AI PROMPT TRICK
lines: Tell the AI who the answer is for.
I asked a local AI: explain what an API is.
It wrote six hundred and fifty words.
Then I added: for a ten year old, two sentences.
Fifty words. Same topic. Far easier to use.
Name your reader, and set a length.

panels.head: PROMPT 2
panels.body: … to a 10-year-old, in 2 sentences, using a restaurant analogy.
